title: Milk Farm Nightmare
setting: Cream Reaper's underground milk farm beneath Tokyo - August 2001
context: Flare was on solo night patrol investigating a serial disappearance case when she encountered Dana Snow (disguised as the Milkman) following a mind-controlled woman. Both were ambushed by the Cream Reaper — his scythe emerged from a dimensional tear and struck Flare in the back, incapacitating her. She and Dana were captured and restrained in the underground milk farm. The Cream Reaper implanted his 'milk cow seed' in both of them, causing their breasts to grow even larger and begin producing milk. For Flare, this triggers traumatic memories — she was created by Doctor Disorder and was once before forced to produce milk. Now she must fight to escape and rescue the 30+ captive women.

character_state.physical_state: Captured, restrained against a wall. Breasts further enlarged and producing milk against her will. Costume damaged.
character_state.mode: Captive — seeking escape to save the other women
